SELECT period, SUM(amount) AS amount
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED
      WHERE account_code = 'rev-gross'
        AND version_id = 2
        AND 1=1
        
        
        
        
      GROUP BY period
      ORDER BY period
